title: dev-loops config
description: Schema for dev-loops config across all layers: the shipped defaults in packages/core/src/config/extension-defaults.yaml, the repo-local .pi/dev-loop/defaults.* override layer, and consumer .devloops (legacy .pi/dev-loop/settings.* and overrides.* still validate against it).

draft.description: Draft gate config. `requireCi` controls whether draft gate waits for green CI.

preApproval.description: Pre-approval gate config. `requireCi` is accepted for parity with runtime config, but preApproval always requires CI so that field has no effect here.

spike.description: Relaxed spike gate profile (#965). Lighter than the production draft -> pre-approval set: a spike's deliverable is a findings doc, so this is a small docs-first angle set, not a required gate, and CI is not a prerequisite. Applies only to spike-mode work.

requireFanoutEvidence.description: Require fan-out/fan-in review evidence on gate verdicts (rejects inline_single_agent).

maxFanoutReviewers.description: Maximum number of fan-out reviewers per gate.

postFindingsComments.description: Whether to post gate findings comments (default true). Local-first keeps them on: findings live on the PR as review evidence.

humanMergeOnly.description: When true, merge is a fixed human-only action: the agent never runs `gh pr merge`, `resolveAutonomyStopAt` always includes "merge", and any per-run merge authorization is ignored (fails closed).

approval.description: Approval / merge-handoff behavior. `humanHandoff` (opt-in) offers to assign the PR to a contributor at the pre-approval gate. Pairs with autonomy.humanMergeOnly.

humanHandoff.description: Offer to assign the PR to a human reviewer/assignee at the pre-approval / merge-handoff boundary. Opt-in; disabled by default. OFFER-only — the operator confirms the assignee.

enabled.description: Enable the human-handoff offer at the pre-approval gate.

candidatesFrom.description: Candidate sources the resolver queries: CODEOWNERS for touched paths and/or recent committers to those paths.

assignees.description: Static, highest-priority candidate logins to offer (e.g. [alice, bob]).

worktree.description: Worktree lifecycle automation. Provision gitignored files/dirs into a fresh worktree from the main checkout. Entries are repo-relative literal paths or glob patterns; directories recurse. Empty/absent is a no-op.

copyOnInit.description: Paths/globs copied into the worktree (isolated per worktree — use for mutable files). Do not target node_modules.

linkOnInit.description: Paths/globs symlinked (absolute) into the main checkout (shared — use only for read-only data). Do not target node_modules.

localPlanning.description: Deprecated (removed in #1088). Accepted for backward compatibility but ignored — nothing reads it.

excludeAngles.description: Angles to remove from the resolved angle list.

requireCi.description: Draft gate CI prerequisite toggle. preApproval remains CI-gated regardless of this flag.

blockCleanOnFindingSeverities.description: Finding severities that block a clean gate verdict.

dynamicAngles.description: Enable dynamic gate angle resolution based on PR diff analysis.

mandatoryAngles.description: Angles that always run regardless of diff-based dynamic selection.
